operations.trigger: naming or reusing a semantic operator
operations.decision_rule: LOTUS-style op ≠ task-capability label ≠ runtime SKILL.md; a name like sem_join gives no guarantee of inherited semantics

operations.operation: read trajectory as evidence, not narration
operations.decision_rule: trust command/exit_code/output/score over message prose; exit_code marks where it broke, not where it erred
applicability / input semantics / operation decision / output constraints / validation-and-repair must all be present

operations.operation: treat row-count change as unverified, not wrong
operations.decision_rule: compare against pre-bound expected relationship; one-to-many may be required; report unverified without evidence
scores without trajectories = symptoms without diagnosis; trajectories without scores = events without verdicts
anchor on exit≠0 steps first, then tail; truncate on budget (default 6000 chars, OPT_HISTORY_CHARS override)

operations.operation: classify per-task trend into five classes
operations.decision_rule: persistent_fail → regressed → flat_partial first; skip stable_success; keep improved

operations.operation: inject history as a bundle, not flat
operations.trigger: feeding history into a skill optimizer
operations.decision_rule: put material in references/history_material.md so main file stays lean (3877 vs 9873 chars)
remove the SKILLOPT_HISTORY_START/END block; verify inject→strip is byte-identical

operations.trigger: wanting to claim the skill mechanism works
operations.decision_rule: split discovery/activation/load/adoption/outcome; zero invocation ≠ zero effect, success invocation ≠ adoption
expand to ≥8 tasks × 2 runs or 4 × 3; replace ceiling/floor tasks (always 1.0 / ~0)

operations.trigger: generations reversing prior rules, zero deletion
operations.decision_rule: cap per-generation diff (≤8 lines), forbid reversals; length is non-monotonic with score
operations.evidence_cite: SkillOpt_两种优化方式分析.md §一/§四

operations.decision_rule: use repeat ≥ 3; treat train/gate/test as disjoint samples; group by data-source family

operations.trigger: body links exist, no read in trace
operations.decision_rule: a link is an entry point, not a load; measure 'resource actually read' separately

operations.anti_pattern: write instance answers / task IDs / test-set columns into the skill
operations.rationale: overfits, pollutes the operator, leaks evaluation; constraints survive task change, answers do not
PowerShell quoting or D:\ path-in-Linux failures are harness bugs, not skill gaps

operations.anti_pattern: gate a skill edit on 4 single-run tasks
operations.rationale: ±0.22 noise ≈ the signal; accept/reject becomes a coin flip
invocation ≠ correct use; measure load and adoption separately
progressive-disclosure benefit is scale/harness-dependent; it is a hypothesis to test

operations.mistake: steer optimization with single-run training scores
operations.fix: use repeat ≥ 3; per-task noise ±0.125 drowns single-run signal
cross-check output artifact and score; a 0-exit step can still compute the wrong granularity/unit/window

operations.decision: SkillOpt = bounded-edit optimizer; this SOP = the history-material front-end (what to feed, how to keep it out of the body)

operations.comparison: this SOP vs SemPipes / EvoDS / EvoSkill
operations.decision: data-science semantic-op optimization is close prior; differentiate via data-semantic state, composition constraints, local feedback

operations.comparison: this SOP vs Skill Blocks / SkillJuror
operations.decision: they already run flat-vs-progressive controls; do not preset deeper-as-better, control knowledge amount

operations.comparison: this SOP vs LOTUS / DocETL / Abacus
operations.decision: those rewrite pipelines; this makes data semantics between operations checkable
if optimization efficiency is the claim, COBRA-Skills is the newer baseline, not hand-written skills
